description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Engineer based in United States. 

 As a Product Engineer, you will help develop and scale digital products designed to make essential services more accessible to people working across borders. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable backend systems while also working across the frontend to deliver seamless product experiences. In this fully remote environment, you will collaborate closely with product and engineering teams distributed around the world. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, improve development processes, and contribute to the evolution of products with global reach. The role encourages experimentation, creative problem-solving, and the thoughtful adoption of new technologies. Your work will directly support the development of a digital platform built around greater flexibility, accessibility, and freedom for remote workers.



Accountabilities:
 
 You will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and designing solutions to implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Working across backend and frontend technologies, you will help deliver clean, maintainable code and scalable product features while collaborating with a distributed team.


 
 Develop and maintain backend services using Kotlin, ensuring clean, efficient, and scalable code.



 
 Contribute to the design and implementation of product features across backend and frontend systems.



 
 Work with TypeScript, React, and Next.js to support engaging and reliable user experiences.



 
 Participate in the full product development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.



 
 Build and improve integrations, data models, and application components using the team's technology stack.



 
 Collaborate with product and engineering colleagues to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.



 
 Explore and adopt relevant technologies and development practices to improve product quality and engineering efficiency.



 
 Contribute ideas, challenge existing approaches, and help shape product and technical processes.




 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate has a strong backend engineering foundation, particularly with Kotlin, as well as familiarity with modern frontend technologies. You are curious, independent, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges in a collaborative, fast-moving environment.


 
 Strong foundation in backend development with Kotlin.



 
 Hands-on experience building backend services and writing clean, scalable, maintainable code.



 
 Familiarity with TypeScript, React, and Next.js.



 
 Understanding of the complete product development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and system design to deployment and maintenance.



 
 Ability to learn new technologies and incorporate them thoughtfully into development work.



 
 Intellectual curiosity and openness to new ideas and approaches.



 
 Independent thinking and confidence in challenging conventional solutions.



 
 Creativity, adaptability, and willingness to experiment, learn from failure, and solve complex problems.



 
 Strong integrity, accountability, and commitment to doing the right thing.



 
 Motivation to contribute to products that improve access to essential services for people around the world.




 Technology Stack:


 
 Kotlin and Java with Micronaut



 
 TypeScript, React, and Next.js



 
 Redux Toolkit and React Query



 
 Styled Components and Tailwind



 
 MySQL, Hibernate, and Liquibase



 
 Google Cloud and Kubernetes




 Benefits: 


 
 Fully remote work: Work from anywhere in the world as part of a globally distributed team.



 
 Transparent compensation and equity: Clear compensation practices and an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.



 
 Global health and travel coverage: Access to a dedicated Global Safety Net providing worldwide health, income, and travel protection.



 
 Generous vacation: A minimum of four weeks of paid vacation per year.



 
 Personal development budget: Annual funding to support learning and professional growth.



 
 Office allowance: Financial support for your remote working setup.



 
 Equipment: A new laptop provided for your work.



 
 Global team gatherings: Annual opportunities to connect with colleagues in inspiring locations around the world.






How Jobgether works:

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
